newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean airliner skids off runway on landing.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean airliner skids off runway on landing.

text.p: A South Korean airliner skidded off a runway on landing in the southern South Korean city of Pusan on Thursday, injuring seven people, airline officials said.
The Korean Air Lines Airbus-300 carrying 273 passengers and eight crew members was flying from the Japanese city of Osaka, they said.
An official at Pusan's Kimhae airport said no one was seriously injured. "All the seven are being treated at a nearby hospital for bruises," she added.
The accident closed down the runway for about 80 minutes, an airline spokesman said.
